name: Tourist/Visit Visa and Business Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Nationality must be on Pakistan's e-Visa/Visa-in-Your-Inbox eligible list (175 countries) or Visa-on-Arrival list (50 countries) to use the streamlined process; other nationalities apply through a Pakistani mission.

Nationality must be on Pakistan's 96-country Business-Friendly List to receive a 5-year multiple-entry business visa within 24 hours; Visa-on-Arrival (30 days) is available for a wider group of business travelers.

evidence_required.document: Proof of accommodation / invitation letter (where applicable)
Business invitation letter via NADRA e-Business Invitation Letter (EBIL) system (business track)

outcome.duration_length: Tourist: 3 months, extendable to 6 months total, double entry. Business: up to 5 years multiple entry (stay per entry not specified in sources located).

sources.title: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports (Ministry of Interior) -- Visa Categories: Tourist/Visit Visa (List-A countries, 3 months double entry, RPO-extendable to 6 months total); Visa in Your Inbox (e-Visa, 175 countries, online pre-arrival authorization); Visa on Arrival (50 countries, 30 days)

DGI&P -- Visa extension guidelines: Business Visa extension up to 6 months with double re-entries inclusive of initial period, for business owners and their family members; multiple business visa for 5 years granted within 24 hours to 96 Business-Friendly List nationals

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Both tracks published on tier-1 government sourcing (DGI&P, part of the Ministry of Interior). The exact per-entry stay length for the 5-year business visa was not specified in the sources retrieved -- flagged as an open gap, not fabricated. A separate e-Business Invitation Letter (EBIL) system (ebil.nadra.gov.pk) exists for inviting foreign business visitors but its detailed criteria were not independently retrieved in this build. Pakistan's NADRA e-Visa portal (visa.nadra.gov.pk), which appears to be the primary applicant-facing system for most categories, returned 403 errors on every fetch attempt in this build -- this file relies on the Ministry of Interior/DGI&P policy pages instead, which describe the same categories at the policy level.
